name: kicad-mcp-pro
description: Drive KiCad schematic, PCB, DRC/ERC, DFM, and manufacturing review from any MCP-capable AI agent.
long_description:
KiCad MCP Pro is a production-grade Model Context Protocol server for KiCad EDA. It exposes schematic capture, PCB layout, ERC/DRC validation, DFM checks, BOM, simulation, and manufacturing export as agent tools.

This bundle is a configuration convenience: it registers the published `kicad-mcp-pro` package with your desktop app so you do not have to hand-edit a JSON config. It is not a fully self-contained one-click install. KiCad (with `kicad-cli`) must already be installed on your system, and `uv` resolves and launches the published package on first run (which needs network access the first time).
